title: Vera suggests the best dates and times for the people who need to be there

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; owner ask 2026-11-24 17:35Z: AI meeting and date management so everyone can brainstorm the best date and time)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-24: Vera's suggestDates offers whole free days for the Space (availability.ts reads unavailable time, events, pencils and day notes); it never offers a time of day and never reads who has to attend. Fix: suggestTimes takes the people, reads each one's assigned entries and team load, their connected Google busy time once calendar sync is live (LIVE-1179), quiet hours and past votes, and proposes three options with one line of reasoning each. Per ADR-1386 Vera only proposes: the options land as pencils for the team to vote on, nothing is booked.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
